{{Quote|Perhaps a different strategy. We need to take more time and plan.|The navigation officer, to Ahsoka Tano|audio=DifferentStrategy-SOR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
A '''clone navigation officer''' was stationed aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] joined a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]&mdash;the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]]&mdash;to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|eliminate]] a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. After the ''Resolute''{{'s}} first attempt failed, the [[Navigator/Legends|navigation officer]] conferred with [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] on a strategy for a second assault. During the planning, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] accidentally let slip [[Gender/Legends|his]] doubt in Tano and remained uncertain with Tano's plan of employing a risky [[Marg Sabl/Legends|Marg Sabl]] maneuver. However, Tano's strategy proved successful and ultimately allowed the Republic to invade and liberate Ryloth.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Naval officer|I'm not sure about this, Commander.|Tano|I&hellip; I think&hellip;|Rex|If we were certain the shields would hold&hellip;|attr=The naval officer and Rex respond to Ahsoka Tano's plan of maneuvering the ''Resolute'' toward the blockade|audio=NotSureAboutThis-SOR.flac|src=<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] served as a [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|naval officer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> At some point, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Navigator/Legends|navigation officer]] was assigned to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was deployed with a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]&mdash;under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]; [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], the ''Resolute''{{'s}} [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]]&mdash;to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|eliminate]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Tano, in her first command position, led a [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|squadron]] of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to attack the blockade. However, the arrival of Confederate reinforcements caused the Republic's offensive to backfire. Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] began [[Death/Legends|suicide]] attacks on the Republic Star Destroyers, and Yularen was severely injured. Returning to the fleet, Tano's [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] was almost completely eradicated. The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] ''Resolute'' and [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] were damaged and forced to retreat, while the cruiser [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']] fell apart under heavy fire.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

[[File:Rex_Ahsoka_Storm_Over_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|250px|The officer confers with Tano and Rex on the bridge of the ''Resolute''.]]
After taking a count of the losses and treating the wounded, Skywalker devised a plan to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the damaged ''Defender'' alone and ram it into the [[Procurer|lead Confederate ship]], eliminating the [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|blockade's commander]] and leaving [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in control of the blockade. Once Skywalker had departed, the clone navigation officer joined Tano and Clone [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Resolute'', and began to devise a plan to take out the remaining Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigates]] in the blockade.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

During the planning, the naval officer accidentally let slip his doubt in Tano's abilities, stating that while Skywalker's strategy was bold, they usually had Skywalker to lead them&mdash;and that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General's]] command of the attack would have ensured its success. He apologized to Tano, not meaning to cause her any offense. After Tano presented a plan to angle the hull of the ''Resolute'' toward the blockade&mdash;allowing [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to be launched, and drawing the Confederate frigates in with a classic [[Marg Sabl/Legends|Marg Sabl]] maneuver&mdash;the officer was doubtful of the Jedi's plan, believing that more [[Time/Legends|time]] and planning was needed to perform a successful attack. However, a revived Yularen supported Tano, and the Padawan was able to secure the defeat of the blockade, allowing Republic reinforcements to land on Ryloth<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> and liberate the planet from Confederate rule.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Yes, but normally we have General Skywalker to lead us and&hellip; I meant no offense, Commander.''"<br />"''None taken.|The naval officer accidentally lets slip his doubt in Ahsoka Tano|audio=NoOffense-SOR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
The naval officer was uncertain of Ahsoka Tano's abilities and accidentally revealed his doubts while planning a counterattack with Captain Rex and Tano, although he apologized. The clone later suggested to Tano that she take more time to plan a strategy, instead of developing a bold plan that maneuvered the ''Resolute'' so that it was completely vulnerable to attack.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> As a clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Databank: clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> the naval officer had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], tan skin,<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> and stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clone troopers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The naval officer, along with all other clones in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], and the officer made his first appearance in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]" as an unidentified character. During the episode, he served as a minor character who helped to expand upon Ahsoka Tano's insecurity with her first position of command.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth Ep Guide" />
